about_the_game:
Start your journey as a local fruit vendor and build your way up to managing a successful and bustling fruit mart. In Fruit Mart Simulator, you are in charge of everything from keeping your produce stocked to managing fruit product stalls, designing your store, and taking care of your customers.

Restock a Variety of Fresh Fruits

Keep your shelves filled with fresh and delicious fruits. Monitor your inventory and restock items like bananas, apples, oranges, melons, and more before they run out. A well-stocked store keeps customers happy and profits steady.

Manage Fruit Product Stalls

Grow your business by operating stalls that serve tasty fruit products including juices, smoothies, fruit skewers, and fruit cocktails. Manage the supply of fresh ingredients for each stall to ensure your customers can always enjoy their favorite treats.

Design and Arrange Your Fruit Store

Customize your store layout to create an inviting and efficient shopping space. Organize fruit baskets, shelves, and product displays to make it easy for customers to browse and buy. A thoughtful layout can improve sales and enhance customer satisfaction.

Process Purchases Smoothly

Handle the checkout counter by processing purchases of fresh fruits and fruit products quickly and accurately. Whether you manage the register yourself or assign it to an employee, smooth transactions help build customer loyalty and grow your reputation.

Are you ready to build the freshest and friendliest fruit mart in town? Get your baskets ready, sharpen your business instincts, and grow your fruit empire in Fruit Mart Simulator.
